svg.title: What ChatGPT's prompt held, December 2025
svg.desc: Seven blocks in the order ChatGPT received them with every message, as reverse engineered in December 2025: system instructions; developer instructions; session metadata such as device and rough location, for this session only; user memory, the saved facts, 33 in the author's case, inserted into every prompt; a summary of recent conversations, about 15 entries, each a time stamp, a chat title and snippets of the user's own messages; the messages of the current chat; and the latest message. No search over past conversations was found.
svg.text: The blocks ChatGPT received with every message, in order, as one person found by asking ChatGPT about its own context.
The two memory blocks are precomputed and inserted whole; he found no search over past chats.
device, browser, rough location, plan; for this session only
the saved facts (33 in his account), inserted into every prompt
about 15 entries: a time stamp, the chat's title, and snippets of the user's own
this chat, in full, up to a token limit he could not find
Reverse engineered by Manthan Gupta, December 2025 [R]; not confirmed by OpenAI
